mission: Master System Design and Distributed Systems
Maintain health, family relationships and financial discipline

weekdayRoutine.title: Wake up, Freshen up, Make bed & Arrange surroundings
weekdayRoutine.description: Wake up on time, drink water, freshen up, make your bed, organize your desk and nearby area, and avoid checking social media. Start the day with a clean environment.

weekdayRoutine.title: LeetCode Practice
weekdayRoutine.description: Solve one LeetCode problem or continue an existing one. Focus on understanding the pattern rather than only getting an accepted solution. Record important learnings if applicable.

weekdayRoutine.title: ByteByteGo Learning
weekdayRoutine.description: Study one ByteByteGo topic related to system design. Write a three-sentence explanation in your own words to reinforce learning.

weekdayRoutine.title: Bath & Get Ready
weekdayRoutine.description: Take a bath, dress for office, and ensure everything required for work is packed before leaving.

weekdayRoutine.title: Breakfast
weekdayRoutine.description: Eat a healthy breakfast without unnecessary scrolling and prepare mentally for the workday.

weekdayRoutine.title: Reach Office / Commute
weekdayRoutine.description: Travel to the office. If possible, listen to a technical podcast or mentally plan the top priorities for the day.

weekdayRoutine.title: Daily Stand-up Meeting
weekdayRoutine.description: Be prepared to explain what you completed yesterday, what you are working on today, and any blockers requiring assistance.

weekdayRoutine.title: Improve One Naming Decision
weekdayRoutine.description: Improve one variable, method, class, API, or database field name to make the codebase more readable and maintainable.

weekdayRoutine.title: Development / Office Work
weekdayRoutine.description: Work on assigned development tasks while considering scalability, maintainability, and code quality. Ask yourself how the solution would behave under 10x traffic.

weekdayRoutine.title: Lunch
weekdayRoutine.description: Take a proper lunch break, relax, and recharge before continuing work.

weekdayRoutine.title: Development / Office Work
weekdayRoutine.description: Continue development work. Before asking anyone for help on a bug, spend at least 10 minutes forming your own hypothesis and investigating the issue.

weekdayRoutine.title: Update JIRA
weekdayRoutine.description: Update ticket status, document progress accurately, and ensure work items reflect the current state.

weekdayRoutine.title: DSM Updates
weekdayRoutine.description: Write what was completed today and what is planned next so that tomorrow starts with clarity.

weekdayRoutine.title: Self Review & Postmortem
weekdayRoutine.description: Write today's key accomplishments, biggest challenge, improvements for tomorrow, and a two-line postmortem explaining what went wrong and what clue led to the solution.

weekdayRoutine.title: Reduce Friction for Tomorrow
weekdayRoutine.description: Prepare tomorrow's LeetCode problem, learning materials, notes, and top priorities so that tomorrow requires minimal effort to begin.

weekdayRoutine.title: Prime Environment for Tomorrow
weekdayRoutine.description: Charge your laptop, clean your desk, keep books visible, organize project files, and arrange everything needed so the productive choice becomes the easiest choice.

weekdayRoutine.title: Structured Learning
weekdayRoutine.description: Complete the scheduled learning activity for the day such as DDIA, Software Design, SRE, OWASP, or writing a design document according to the weekly plan.

weekdayRoutine.title: Job Applications
weekdayRoutine.description: Apply to 3-5 quality jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, or company career pages. Respond to recruiters and save interesting opportunities for follow-up.

weekdayRoutine.title: Relax / Talk to Her / Snacks
weekdayRoutine.description: Take a mental break by talking, relaxing, or having snacks. Avoid excessive screen time that does not help recovery.

weekdayRoutine.title: Cooking
weekdayRoutine.description: Prepare dinner and, if convenient, prepare ingredients or food that will reduce effort for the next day.

weekdayRoutine.title: Talk to Parents
weekdayRoutine.description: Call your parents, ask about their health and day, share your updates, and check whether they need any support.

weekdayRoutine.title: Dinner
weekdayRoutine.description: Eat dinner peacefully and avoid unnecessary distractions while eating.

weekdayRoutine.title: Free Time / Talk / Relax
weekdayRoutine.description: Spend quality time talking to loved ones, relaxing, enjoying hobbies, or completing light household work if necessary.

weekdayRoutine.title: Book Reading
weekdayRoutine.description: Read a technical or non-technical book before sleeping to build a long-term reading habit and continuous learning mindset.

Monday.title: Cursor + A Philosophy of Software Design
Monday.description: Explore one new Cursor feature that you have never used before during office hours. In the evening, read one chapter of A Philosophy of Software Design and note key learnings.

Tuesday.title: DDIA + Design Document
Tuesday.description: Read one chapter or section of Designing Data-Intensive Applications and write a design document for a current or upcoming feature including APIs, database design and trade-offs.

Wednesday.title: DDIA + Google SRE Book
Wednesday.description: Read one chapter or section of DDIA and one chapter of the Google SRE Book. Focus on reliability, monitoring and operational excellence.

Thursday.title: DDIA + OWASP Review
Thursday.description: Read one DDIA section and study one OWASP Top 10 vulnerability. Evaluate one API from your project against that vulnerability.

Friday.title: DDIA + Metrics + Resume Improvement
Friday.description: Read one DDIA section, monitor one API or business flow metrics, update .cursorrules if required, and improve your Resume/LinkedIn/Naukri profile.

weekendRoutine.title: Wake up, Freshen up, Make bed & Arrange surroundings
weekendRoutine.description: Wake up on time, drink water, freshen up, make your bed, organize your room and workspace, and start the day with a clean environment.

weekendRoutine.title: Breakfast
weekendRoutine.description: Eat a healthy breakfast and prepare mentally for deep learning sessions.

weekendRoutine.title: LeetCode / Contest Practice
weekendRoutine.description: Practice challenging problems or participate in contests. Focus on learning patterns and reviewing mistakes rather than simply solving problems.

weekendRoutine.title: ByteByteGo Learning
weekendRoutine.description: Study one system design topic and write a short summary in your own words.

weekendRoutine.title: Bath & Refresh
weekendRoutine.description: Take a bath and refresh yourself before continuing the day's activities.

weekendRoutine.title: Buy Fruits & Weekly Grocery Check
weekendRoutine.description: Purchase fruits and check whether groceries or household essentials need replenishment for the coming week.

weekendRoutine.title: Cooking
weekendRoutine.description: Prepare healthy meals and, if possible, reduce future effort by preparing ingredients for upcoming days.

weekendRoutine.title: Lunch
weekendRoutine.description: Enjoy lunch and take a short break before resuming learning activities.

weekendRoutine.title: DDIA Reading
weekendRoutine.description: Read one chapter or section of Designing Data-Intensive Applications and note important concepts and trade-offs.

weekendRoutine.title: Cooking
weekendRoutine.description: Prepare dinner and organize anything that can reduce effort during the upcoming week.

weekendRoutine.title: Talk to Parents
weekendRoutine.description: Call your parents, ask about their health and day, share your updates, and check whether they need any support.

weekendRoutine.title: Dinner
weekendRoutine.description: Eat dinner peacefully and avoid unnecessary distractions.

weekendRoutine.title: Free Time / Relax
weekendRoutine.description: Relax, spend time with loved ones, pursue hobbies, or complete light household work if required.

weekendRoutine.title: Book Reading
weekendRoutine.description: Read a technical or non-technical book before sleeping to build a lifelong reading habit.

Sunday.title: Measure Weight
Sunday.description: Measure your weight immediately after waking up and before breakfast. Record it in your tracker to monitor long-term health trends.

Sunday.title: Weekly Kitchen Cleaning
Sunday.description: Clean the kitchen counter, stove/induction, sink, utensils area, and organize frequently used items for the upcoming week.

Sunday.title: Mock System Design Interview
Sunday.description: Practice a complete system design interview by explaining your approach aloud or recording yourself. Review your communication and technical decisions afterward.

Sunday.title: LeetCode / Codeforces Contest
Sunday.description: Participate seriously in a coding contest. After completion, review incorrect solutions and learn better approaches.

Sunday.title: Weekly Career Review
Sunday.description: Review jobs applied, recruiter responses, interview progress, resume improvements, and define next week's career objectives.

Sunday.title: Weekly Knowledge Review
Sunday.description: Review your LeetCode notes, DDIA learnings, System Design notes, and mistakes made during the week to strengthen retention.

Sunday.title: Wash Clothes
Sunday.description: Wash and organize clothes for the upcoming week. Prepare office clothes in advance to reduce Monday morning friction.

Sunday.title: Weekly Planning
Sunday.description: Plan the next week's top work goals, learning goals, personal goals, and important tasks so Monday starts with clarity.

Saturday.title: Design One System from Scratch
Saturday.description: Choose a real-world system and design its APIs, database, cache, messaging, scaling strategy, and failure handling. Compare your design with a reference solution.

Saturday.title: Personal Project Development
Saturday.description: Build or improve your personal project by implementing one meaningful feature, fixing technical debt, or experimenting with a new technology.

Saturday.title: MIT 6.824 Distributed Systems Lecture
Saturday.description: Watch one MIT 6.824 lecture attentively and write down the key concepts and practical lessons learned.

monthlyTasks.title: Monthly Financial Planning
monthlyTasks.description: Review your salary, expenses, savings, investments, SIPs, emergency fund, pending bills, and budget. Set financial goals and an investment plan for the next month.

monthlyTasks.title: Digital Cleanup
monthlyTasks.description: Clean your Downloads folder, organize Desktop files, remove unnecessary screenshots, archive old notes, organize bookmarks, and clean unused browser tabs.

atomicHabits.title: Reduce Friction
atomicHabits.description: Before ending the day, prepare tomorrow's LeetCode problem, learning material, notes, clothes, and priorities so that starting tomorrow requires minimal effort.

atomicHabits.title: Prime Environment
atomicHabits.description: Arrange your workspace, charge your laptop, keep books visible, organize project files, and prepare everything needed so the desired behavior becomes the easiest behavior.

dailyPrinciples.title: Think for Scale
dailyPrinciples.description: For every feature ask: 'How would I design this if it needed to handle 10x traffic?'

dailyPrinciples.title: PR Self Review
dailyPrinciples.description: Review your own pull request as if you were the reviewer before requesting review from others.

dailyPrinciples.title: Explain What You Learn
dailyPrinciples.description: After learning any concept, write a three-sentence explanation in your own words to improve retention.

dailyPrinciples.title: Bug Postmortem
dailyPrinciples.description: For every significant bug, write two lines: what was wrong and what clue led you to the solution.

dailyPrinciples.title: Hypothesis Before Asking
dailyPrinciples.description: Before asking anyone for help on a bug, spend at least 10 minutes forming your own hypothesis and investigating.

dailyPrinciples.title: Failure Analysis
dailyPrinciples.description: Whenever designing or implementing something, ask: 'What happens if this fails? What's the fallback?'

dailyPrinciples.title: Continuous Job Search
dailyPrinciples.description: Apply to 3-5 quality jobs every weekday and keep your Resume, LinkedIn, and Naukri profiles updated.

dailyPrinciples.title: Continuous Improvement
dailyPrinciples.description: Aim to become 1% better every day by improving code quality, communication, learning, or personal habits.

lifeRules.title: Health First
lifeRules.description: Sleep on time, eat healthy food, monitor your weight weekly, and prioritize long-term health over short-term convenience.

lifeRules.title: Family Comes First
lifeRules.description: Talk to your parents every day and maintain meaningful relationships with your loved ones.

lifeRules.title: Build Instead of Consume
lifeRules.description: Whenever possible, spend your free time creating projects, writing, or learning instead of passive consumption.

lifeRules.title: Document Your Knowledge
lifeRules.description: Keep notes for algorithms, system design, debugging experiences, and engineering insights so future you benefits from present effort.

yearlyGoals.title: Crack a Top Product Company
yearlyGoals.description: Become interview-ready for companies like Google by strengthening DSA, System Design, and Software Engineering skills.

yearlyGoals.title: Build Strong Engineering Expertise
yearlyGoals.description: Complete DDIA, Google SRE Book, A Philosophy of Software Design, MIT 6.824 lectures, and maintain practical projects.

yearlyGoals.title: Maintain Financial Discipline
yearlyGoals.description: Track expenses monthly, increase savings and investments, and continuously improve financial planning.

yearlyGoals.title: Build a Portfolio of Projects
yearlyGoals.description: Continuously improve personal projects so they demonstrate real engineering skills and strengthen your resume.
